title: peniocereus zopilotensis
intro: Peniocereus zopilotensis, commonly known as the Zopilote cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Peniocereus. It is used in traditional medicine in Mexico, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Peniocereus zopilotensis include antiseptic, antimicrobial, and wound-healing properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Bioactive constituents of Peniocereus zopilotensis have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its traditional use in treating various health conditions.
